hook.en: Does a pea that inherits a yellow colour also have to inherit a round shape? Mendel tracked two traits together to find out.

body.en: Crossing round yellow (RRYY) with wrinkled green (rryy) gives round yellow F1 (RrYy). The F1 forms four kinds of gametes in equal numbers: RY, Ry, rY, ry. The F2 shows 9 round yellow : 3 round green : 3 wrinkled yellow : 1 wrinkled green. Law of independent assortment: when two pairs of traits are combined in a hybrid, segregation of one pair is independent of the other.
body.kn: ದುಂಡು ಹಳದಿ (RRYY) × ಸುಕ್ಕು ಹಸಿರು (rryy) → F1 RrYy. F2 ಅನುಪಾತ 9:3:3:1. ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ವಿಂಗಡಣೆಯ ನಿಯಮ: ಒಂದು ಜೊತೆ ಲಕ್ಷಣದ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕತೆ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರಿಂದ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ.

say.en: Round yellow RRYY crossed with wrinkled green rryy gives round yellow F1, RrYy. The F1 makes four kinds of gametes in equal numbers.
Sixteen combinations give 9 round yellow, 3 round green, 3 wrinkled yellow, 1 wrinkled green. Each pair segregates independently: the law of independent assortment.
Morgan found that genes on the same chromosome tend to stay together: linkage. Yellow body and white eye are tightly linked; white eye and miniature wing much less.
Crossing over makes recombinants. The recombination frequency measures the distance between genes; Sturtevant used it to map genes.

body.en: Mendel's work was rediscovered in 1900 by de Vries, Correns and von Tschermak. Sutton and Boveri proposed the chromosomal theory of inheritance: genes lie on chromosomes, which segregate and assort independently in meiosis. Thomas Hunt Morgan, using Drosophila, found that genes on the same chromosome tend to stay together (linkage) and that new combinations arise by crossing over (recombination). Tightly linked genes such as yellow body and white eye showed 1.3% recombination; white eye and miniature wing showed 37.2%. Sturtevant used recombination frequency to map genes on chromosomes.
body.kn: ಸಟ್ಟನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬೊವೆರಿ ವರ್ಣತಂತು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಮಂಡಿಸಿದರು. ಮೋರ್ಗನ್ ಡ್ರೊಸೊಫಿಲಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಲಗ್ನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡರು. ಸ್ಟರ್ಟೆವಂಟ್ ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಆವರ್ತನದಿಂದ ಜೀನ್ ನಕ್ಷೆ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದರು.

narration.en: Mendel's work was rediscovered in 1900 by de Vries, Correns and von Tschermak. Thomas Hunt Morgan, using Drosophila, found that genes on the same chromosome tend to stay together (linkage) and that new combinations arise by crossing over (recombination). problem.en: How many kinds of gametes does a plant of genotype AaBbCC produce?

steps.en: Number of kinds of gametes = 2ⁿ, where n is the number of heterozygous gene pairs.
Aa and Bb are heterozygous; CC is homozygous. So n = 2.

body.en: For n heterozygous gene pairs: kinds of gametes = 2ⁿ, F2 genotypes = 3ⁿ, F2 phenotypes (complete dominance) = 2ⁿ, Punnett boxes = 4ⁿ.
